Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is a trusted provider of mission-enabling solutions for global security. We have a wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies. Our differentiated battle management and cyber solutions deliver timely, mission-enabling information and provide superior situational awareness and understanding to protect the U.S. and its global allies.

Entry Level opportunities at Northrop Grumman are unique. Are you interested in boosting your knowledge through experience and exposure, while supporting a mission that seeks to protect our nation and its allies?  If so, then Northrop Grumman is the place you!

- Develop or troubleshoot electrical designs using common engineering/office tools (including MatLab, LT Spice, MS Office) for analytical techniques and electrical simulation

- Support in assessing candidate components for use in designs and curating their implementation into design tool libraries

- Implement circuit designs in electrical CAD programs such as Siemens Xpedition and Capital Logic, gaining experience in circuit layout on printed wire boards, interconnects, and engineering drawing development

- Utilize electrical test equipment (DC power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes, network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, etc)

- Be introduced to design and testing experience with Sonar receivers and subsea electronics

- Contribute to progressing designs through conceptualization, prototyping, finalized design, manufacturing, test and fielding.

- Be completing or has completed their Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution

- Be majoring in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a closely related STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) degree.

At Northrop Grumman UK, you are part of a team driving innovation where it matters most, solving tomorrow’s challenges and shaping the technology solutions of the future. It’s what we call Defining Possible.

This mindset goes beyond our customer solutions. It is the foundation for your career development and the impact we have within the community.

This is more than just a job. It’s a mission.

Join our Cyber & Intelligence business and become part of a growing Operational Effects team that is building the next generation of AI-enabled products for national security and government customers.

As an AI Product Engineer, you will help create proprietary software capabilities that deliver operational advantage, strengthen existing programmes, and unlock future growth opportunities. This is a unique opportunity to join at an early stage and play a key role in establishing and scaling a new AI product engineering capability within Northrop Grumman UK.

Working alongside engineers, technical specialists and users, you will take products from concept through to adoption. You will help shape technical direction, influence product strategy, and deliver innovative solutions using modern AI technologies including large language models (LLMs), retrieval augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows.

If you enjoy solving real-world problems, experimenting with emerging technologies and building software that has meaningful impact, this could be the opportunity for you.

What you’ll be doing

You will:

- Design, build and maintain AI-enabled software products that support operational mission outcomes.
- Develop capabilities using LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic workflows and other emerging AI technologies.
- Work directly with users and stakeholders to understand challenges and translate requirements into valuable product features.
- Contribute to product roadmaps, software architecture decisions and engineering standards.
- Implement robust engineering practices including testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability and supportability.
- Support technical demonstrations, stakeholder engagement activities, innovation initiatives and recruitment efforts.

What we’re looking for

We are interested in hearing from people who can demonstrate:

- Experience designing, developing or supporting software products or applications.
- Knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including testing, version control and continuous integration.
- Experience or strong interest in AI technologies, machine learning, LLMs, RAG solutions or intelligent automation.
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work through complex technical challenges.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
- The ability to work effectively both independently and within collaborative multidisciplinary teams.

Desirable experience

- Defence, national security, government or advanced technology sector experience.
- Experience developing AI-enabled products or data-driven applications.
- Exposure to cloud-native technologies, modern software architectures and DevOps practices.
- Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to technical leadership activities.
- Degree qualification in a relevant discipline, although equivalent experience is equally valued.

Even if you do not meet every requirement, we would still encourage you to apply. We value diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and recognise that great potential can come from many different career paths.

Security Clearance

Due to the nature of our work, you must be a British Citizen to be considered for this opportunity.

You must be able to gain and maintain UK Government Security Check (SC) clearance.

Our recruitment team is on hand to answer any questions and will guide you through the process: talentenquiries@uk.ngc.com

Benefits

At Northrop Grumman UK, we offer a competitive rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, career development and lifestyle, including:

- Flexible working options, including compressed fortnight arrangements where applicable
- Private healthcare
- Cash health plan
- Annual performance bonus opportunities
- Holiday buy and sell scheme
- Career development and learning programmes
- Professional accreditation support
- Pension scheme
- Employee assistance programme
- Inclusive employee networks and communities

Why Join Us?

A Mission to Believe In

Every day, our teams contribute to building a more secure and connected world. Whether developing innovative AI solutions or solving complex operational challenges, your work will have meaningful real-world impact.

A Place to Belong and Thrive

We believe innovation is driven by diverse perspectives and experiences. Every voice matters at our table, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed.

Your Career, Your Way

As our AI product engineering capability expands, so too will the opportunities available to you. Whether you want to deepen your technical expertise, develop as a leader, or explore emerging technologies, you'll have the support and development needed to shape your own career journey.

Ready to Apply?

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems (DS) is seeking a Computer Support 2 candidate to join its dynamic team of technical cyber professionals in the Roy, Utah area.

Roles and responsibilities will include:

• Provide weekly verification of PC and other peripheral inventory across different networks.

• Act as a liaison between various teams in multiple tasking and inventory coordination.

• Experience and learn more about cyber security methods and processes.

• Utilize inventory database and other tools for accurate and efficient record keeping.

Ideal candidates will possess and demonstrate the following characteristics: able to prioritize and execute tasks in a collaborative team environment within schedules and timelines, strong attention to detail and interpersonal skills, ability to work with minimal supervision, both independently and within a team and have excellent organizational, analytical and interpersonal skills.

Basic Requirements:

- High School diploma or equivalent with 2 years of additional education and/or experience. US citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain clearance

- Must have the ability to obtain a DoD Secret level security clearance within a reasonable period as determined by the company and by program and/or customer requirements; maintaining the required security clearance will be a condition of continued employment.

- The selected candidate will be required to obtain a Special Access Programs (SAP/SAR) clearance within a specific time frame as determined by customer and/or program requirements; maintaining SAP/SAR will be a condition of continued employment.

- Experience troubleshooting, installing, and configuring Desktops running Windows OS (including Windows 10), as well as the Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word).

- DoD 8570 IAT Level II baseline certification within 6 months of hire date(example: Security+ CE).

- The ability to lift 40 pounds.

- The ability to work after hours and/or weekends as needed.

- Must be able to work shifts from 6am - 7pm

Preferred Qualifications:

- Have an active U.S. Government DoD Top Secret security clearance at time of application, current and within scope, with an ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) approval within a reasonable period, as determined by the company to meet its business need.

- Bachelor's degree in relevant field.

- CompTIA A+, Network+, Dell, HP, or other certification(s).

- Experience with remote administration.

- Experience with PowerShell scripting.

- Experience with zero and/or thin client devices.

- Experience in Active Directory configuring user and computer accounts.

- Cross-platform experience (i.e. two or more of the following: Windows, Linux, Solaris, OSX, UNIX, etc.).

- Experience supporting VMware VDI (Virtual Desktop Infrastructure).

CIDO

postings.title: Cyber Resarcher
postings.description:
UK CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED FOR THIS POSITION: Yes

RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Job Title: Cyber Researcher
Requisition ID: R10248052
Location: Cheltenham, UK
Clearance Type: DV Preferred

What’s your possible?

At Northrop Grumman UK, you are part of a team driving innovation where it matters most, solving tomorrow’s challenges and shaping the technology solutions of the future. It’s what we call Defining Possible.

This mindset goes beyond our customer solutions. It underpins how we support your career development, encourage innovation, and create meaningful impact for our customers and communities.

This is more than just a job. It’s a mission.

Join our Cyber & Intelligence business and help tackle some of the most complex challenges facing government and national security organisations today.

As a Cyber Technologist (Research), you will apply innovative thinking, technical curiosity and rigorous experimentation to solve difficult customer problems. Working within our Operational Effects capability area, you will conduct applied research, investigate emerging technologies, and develop novel solutions that deliver real operational impact.

Whether you are an experienced researcher, a cyber specialist looking to expand your influence, or a technical expert passionate about innovation, this role offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of national security challenges while contributing to technology that makes a difference.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, engage directly with customers, and help shape future capabilities through technical leadership, experimentation and insight.

What you’ll be doing

You will:

- Conduct applied research to explore and solve complex cyber and technology challenges.
- Design and deliver technical investigations, experiments and proof-of-concept activities.
- Develop prototypes, demonstrations and innovative technical solutions.
- Produce clear technical reports, recommendations and customer briefings.
- Provide specialist advice and support to customers, stakeholders and delivery teams.
- Contribute to innovation activities, business development opportunities and future capability growth.

What we’re looking for

We are interested in hearing from people who can demonstrate:

- Relevant experience delivering technical solutions, research activities or innovation projects within cyber, technology, defence, intelligence, security or related domains.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex technical challenges.
- Experience communicating technical concepts to a range of audiences through reports, presentations and workshops.
- The ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
- A proactive approach to learning and maintaining expertise in emerging technologies.
- Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and customer focus.

Desirable experience

- Defence, national security, intelligence or government sector experience.
- Experience delivering applied research, experimentation or advanced technology programmes.
- Experience mentoring colleagues or providing technical leadership.
- Degree-qualified in a relevant discipline, although equivalent experience is equally valued.

Even if you do not meet every requirement, we would still encourage you to apply. We value diverse experiences, perspectives and approaches to problem-solving.

Security Clearance

Due to the nature of our work, you must be a British Citizen to be considered for this opportunity.

You must be able to gain and maintain UK Government security clearance, with Developed Vetting (DV) preferred for this role.

Our recruitment team is on hand to answer any questions and guide you through the clearance process: talentenquiries@uk.ngc.com

Benefits

At Northrop Grumman UK, we offer a competitive rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, career and lifestyle, including:

- Flexible working options, including compressed fortnight arrangements where applicable
- Private healthcare
- Cash health plan
- Annual performance bonus opportunities
- Holiday buy and sell scheme
- Career development and learning programmes
- Professional accreditation support
- Pension scheme
- Employee assistance programme
- Inclusive employee networks and communities

Why Join Us?

A Mission to Believe In

Every day, our teams contribute to building a more secure and connected world. From cyber and intelligence capabilities to pioneering technologies, the work you do will have real-world impact where it matters most.

A Place to Belong and Thrive

We believe innovation comes from diverse perspectives. Every voice matters at our table, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed.

Your Career, Your Way

Whether you are developing specialist expertise, expanding into leadership, or exploring new technologies, you will have the support, mentorship and opportunities needed to shape a career that is uniquely yours.

Ready to Apply?

Yes – Submit your application online today.

Possibly – Want to learn more? Contact our team at talentenquiries@uk.ngc.com

No – Explore our other opportunities across Northrop Grumman UK. We are growing across the UK and are always looking for talented people who want to help us define possible.

Northrop Grumman is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce, and encourages individuals from all backgrounds and all abilities to apply and consider becoming a part of our diverse and inclusive workforce.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is looking for you to join our team as an Electronic Technician 2, based out of Rolling Meadows, IL.

What you will get to do:

- Work from schematics, diagrams, written and verbal descriptions, layouts or defined plans to perform routine testing, checkout, troubleshooting, environmental testing, and simple developmental engineering tasks.

- Diagnose and isolate malfunctions down to component level.
- Conduct defined engineering tests and collects data as assigned.
- Utilize routine development or diagnostic equipment including oscilloscope, DVM, signal generators and similar test apparatus.

Basic Qualifications for the Electronic Technician 2:

- High School diploma and a minimum of 2 years of electronics experience troubleshooting complex circuits and devices
- Experience using measuring and monitoring equipment such as oscilloscopes, function/waveform generators, power supplies, multi-meters, current sensors, and probes
- Experience reading and interpreting wiring diagrams and schematics
- Ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Secret Clearance
- US citizen

Preferred Qualifications:

- Associate of Science degree or higher (or Technical degree) in electronic technology or electronics focused major OR graduate of a two-year, full time electronic technology school or six months of military electronics school
- Experience with Microsoft Office applications (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, & TEAMS)
- Experience using SAP Manufacturing Execution System (MES) software to document testing performed, enter test results, & create Quality Notifications for any discrepancies found
- Military experience working with electronic equipment/systems
- Experience with continuous improvement and process improvement principles
- Current, active Secret Clearance

The qualified applicant will become part of Northrop Grumman's Manufacturing Engineering team, where they will work on Infrared Countermeasures (IRCM) suite of products as a Process Engineer.

Manufacturing Engineers thrive in an environment of daily unique challenges and proximity to products. Partnering with production, successful process engineers lead troubleshooting and ensure excellence in hardware and software. Engineers who do well in this setting enjoy seeing their work perform in a test or a product, collaborate and communicate well across functions, and are innovative problem solvers. Best suited to this role are those who enjoy learning and bring a sense of urgency and energy to their tasks.

What you will get to do:

Support for Production:

- Support the production floor and assembly technicians with timely technical guidance
- Support/collaborate with Design Engineering, Project Management, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Quality organizations to meet manufacturing contractual commitment
- Perform hands-on troubleshooting of IRCM Transmitters and Sensors

Process Development/Maintenance:

- Generate and maintain/revise Manufacturing Engineering process specifications, work instructions, routers, tooling/fixturing and equipment

- Investigate, design, and provide solutions to support nonconformance repair procedures, review/generate change notices, etc.

Continuous improvement:

- Implement continuous improvement initiatives to reduce cost, cycle time, defects.
- Analyze assembly/workmanship failures and failure data to identify trends; create failure analysis materials such as failure charts, quad charts, and customer presentations
- Lead/support root cause investigations and implement corrective actions
- Work with suppliers to resolve technical hardware issues

Design:

- Collaborate with design engineering to achieve producibility in new and updated product design
- Contribute to research, design, development, and assembly activities for a variety of development products; execute hardware assembly and integration activities
- Lead / support Non-Recurring (NRE) projects, including test fixture/tooling design, drawings, parts lists / bills of materials, updating process documentation, and validation

Basic Qualifications for the Process Engineer:

- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Engineering Technology and a minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience; OR a master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Engineering Technology
- Experience with fixture/tooling design and implementation
- Experience with continuous improvement, data analysis, and root cause/corrective action
- Ability to obtain a Secret Clearance
- US Citizenship required

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience with Nx / CAD

- Experience in manufacturing environment

- Experience supporting design/development projects

- Experience presenting to key stakeholders

- Experience with IRCM products

What We Can Offer You:

Northrop Grumman provides a comprehensive benefits package and a work environment which encourages your growth and supports the mutual success of our people and our company. Northrop Grumman benefits give you the flexibility and control to choose the benefits that make the most sense for you and your family.

THE FOLLOWING ARE THE USUAL MAJOR JOB DUTIES BUT THIS JOB DESCRIPTION DOES NOT PRECLUDE THE PERFORMANCE OF OTHER DUTIES WITHIN THE OCCUPATION BY THE INCUMBENT, NOR THE QUESTION BEING RAISED ON THE PROPER RATE OF PAY FOR THE ASSIGNMENT.

Perform the duties of Inspector C and in addition:

- Determine and utilize inspection procedures, set-up necessary inspection tools and equipment where fixtures are not provided such as: measuring microscope, Rockwell hardness tester, profilometer, height gauge, Cadillac gauge, dial indicator, parallel bars, right angle knee, gauge blocks, precision pins, bench center, V blocks, sine bar, surface plate, optical comparator (shadow graph) computer-aided measuring equipment, laser measuring devices and the like. Work from additional information such as sketches and Westinghouse/Government/Military specifications.

- Make necessary measurements, check accuracy, set and adjust precision inspection equipment and special manufacturing acceptance tools and fixtures, where methods and procedures have been established and complexity is within the scope of this description. Select and utilize gauge stands such as super micrometers, torque calibrator, planekator, indiron, standard measuring machine, master gauges, optical plat, precision comparator thread setting plug/ring gauge and the like and inspect proto-type electronic assemblies and complex micro-circuit assemblies.

- When detected, record drawing errors and deviations from applicable specifications. Make necessary mathematical calculations to determine dimensions such as thickness, depth, angle, tapers, arcs, volumes, areas and physical characteristics such as elongation, shear strength, etc. Notify manufacturing/supervision and/or higher classified personnel of any such deviations or defects occurring in an area and identify needs for remedial actions.

- Inspect shipment and shipping paperwork such as Government/Customer shipping documents, contracts waivers/deviations, packaging and preservation information and the like to applicable specifications and sign to verify acceptance by Quality Control.

- Perform first piece, patrol, sampling, PCA (Physical Conjuration Audit) and final inspection on a variety of complete electro-mechanical LRU's, Systems and fabricated mechanical assemblies. Visually inspect for factors such as shaft and bearing alignment, sliding fits and alignments and conformance to appropriate electrical assembly specifications and standards. Assist higher classified inspection personnel in performing first article inspection.

- Inspect castings and forging where prior sample approval has been given. Inspect machined parts and Sheetmetal fabrications of a complex nature which are characterized by such factors as many related dimensions, a variety of arcs, curves, and compound angles, irregular contours and an absence of locating surfaces, to assure conformity to quality specifications.

- Inspect spotwelded and/or fusion welded assemblies for dimension and weld quality. Check set-up of spotwelding equipment including time, pressure and current controls of machines, tip size and shape. Periodically witness result of micro-tech and mechanical tests for penetration strength and location of weld. Perform non-destructive inspection such as dye penetrant, magnetic particle, ultrasonic and review of X-ray film of electronic assemblies also to identify imperfections.

- Perform first piece tool and tape inspection approvals where procedures have been established and the approval consists of inspecting pieces that is within the complexity of this description. This would include such approvals as electronic cable form boards, manufacturing product samples, mill and/or drill tools, Sheetmetal templates and the like.

- Maintain equipment and work area in a clean and orderly condition and maintain records of equipment calibrated.

This is a 4th Shift position.

-High School Diploma or recognized equivalent.

-Must be able to pass a validated Inspector B Test.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is a trusted provider of mission-enabling solutions for global security. We have a wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies. Our differentiated battle management and cyber solutions deliver timely, mission-enabling information and provide superior situational awareness and understanding to protect the U.S. and its global allies.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is seeking a Junior Aircraft Mechanic to join its team. This position is located in Linthicum, Maryland.

Primary Function:

Troubleshoots, repairs and services aircraft and engine systems. Conducts diagnosis of malfunctions. Performs maintenance, disassembly, rework, repair, replacement, re-assembly or adjustment of various aircraft systems in accordance with technical specifications, engineering instructions, and FAA regulations. Maintains FAA required records, manuals and inspection forms.

WORKING PROCEDURE AND/OR RESPONSIBILITY ASSIGNED:

PERFORM WORK OF EQUAL OR LOWER SKILL LEVEL AS REQUIRED.

1. Complete inspection, maintenance, modification and servicing of aircraft and ground support equipment. Work from such information as applicable maintenance manuals, technical directives, drawings, process specifications and oral and/or written instructions. Maintain knowledge of the complete aircraft including aircraft structures, components, power plants and mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic and electrical systems and the interrelationships of the various systems.Certify all required work.

2. Schedule various operations to be performed and perform all operations according to master schedule. Follow all phases of schedule commitments and maintain current status of aircraft at all times. Prepare status reports as necessary. Notify supervision of schedule delays and problems encountered and make recommendations to resolve such situations. Answer numerous inquiries concerning the status of and coordinate the performance of various tests as necessary.

3. Assist supervision in determining ground support equipment, spare parts and other necessary equipment necessary to support aircraft.Devise and improvise necessary special tooling and equipment which are required to maintain aircraft.

4. Discuss functional requirements, problems with systems, components and material utilized on aircraft with supervision, to resolve problems concerning modifications and maintenance to be performed.Check to ensure that all test equipment used is calibrated according to schedule.

5. Keep abreast of and ensure compliance with all applicable federal government and civilian regulations and the like pertaining to the maintenance and modification of aircraft.

6. Provide continuous training to aircrews in the use and care of aircrew life support and training or egress systems and/or associated life support equipment for non-related personnel prior to participating in flying activities on ground engine/systems operation.

7. Maintain accurate records of all actions taken or required on the aircraft in accordance with all FAA and military regulations.Perform inventory of all aircraft records and check records ensure that aircraft is current.Prepare reports on items to be accomplished on aircraft.Furnish personnel on floor with necessary logs, regulations, inspection cards and the like.Prepare various periodic and special examination reports as required by company and government directives.Order and maintain all publications applicable to various aircraft.

8. Maintain work area, hangar, ramp, shops and ground support equipment in a clean and orderly fashion.Perform other miscellaneous duties which may fall within the scope of this position.

This is a 1st Shift Position

Education Requirement:

- High school graduate or the equivalent.

- Federal Aviation Administration Airframe and Power Plant Certificate required.

Experience Requirement:

- 0-3 years experience as an aircraft mechanic in the military, industrial or commercial aviation field.

- Must be current in the aviation field (worked in the field or obtained licensure within the previous 24 months) and possess an A&P license.
